_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Vrooli Bridge are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `vrooli scenario generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

dashboard.title: Dashboard

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Trusted Vrooli nodes in your fleet.
fleet.empty: No nodes registered yet. Pair a node to see it here.
fleet.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? This severs the node immediately.

pairing.heading: Pair a node
pairing.description: Mint a single-use code, then run the bootstrap installer on the new node with it.
pairing.codeHelp: Shown once. Deliver it out-of-band to the node's installer.

onboard.heading: Onboard a node
onboard.description: Point the control plane at a raw SSH host — it drives the host from bare OS to a paired, online fleet agent in one durable operation.
onboard.passwordHelp: Used once to install the onboarding key, then discarded. Leave blank if the host already trusts the bridge key. Never stored in the browser.
onboard.capabilitiesHelp: Comma-separated verb namespaces the node self-reports.
onboard.revisionHelp: @cp is the control plane's current commit. Accepts an explicit SHA or branch.
onboard.viewNode: See it in the fleet below.
onboard.retryHint: Fix the issue above, then start onboarding again — every step is idempotent, so a re-run converges.

failure.ssh_setup_failed: Could not establish passwordless SSH to the host. Check it is reachable on the SSH port, the user is correct, and the password was right.
failure.script_push_failed: Could not copy the bootstrap script to the host. Check remote disk space and temp-dir write access.
failure.pairing_issue_failed: The control plane could not issue a pairing code. Check the owner credentials and control-plane health.
failure.bootstrap_usage_error: The bootstrap script rejected its arguments. This is a control-plane defect, not a host problem — capture the op id and file a bug.
failure.unsupported_platform: The node runs an unsupported platform. macOS onboarding is gated; onboard a Linux host, or wait for cross-platform support.
failure.pairing_failed: Pairing was rejected on the node: the single-use code was already consumed or expired. Start onboarding again to reissue a fresh code.
failure.bootstrap_failed: The bootstrap script failed on the node. Inspect the failing step above and fix the node condition.
failure.verify_online_failed: The node bootstrapped but did not come online within the verification budget. Check the node-agent service and its dial-out path to the control plane.
failure.interrupted_by_restart: The control plane restarted mid-onboarding. The op is safe to retry.
failure.internal_error: An unexpected control-plane error ended the op. Capture the op id and control-plane logs.
failure.generic: Onboarding did not complete. Inspect the step history above.
